scope: Initial visual audit before approved replacements. Global source files were not modified by this reviewer.
rendering: Engine-equivalent body width 190, per-body anchors, ear sink 0.36 and per-ear rotation. Review omits lighting/shading to isolate shapes and uses face_01/prop_15 consistently.

recommended_replacements.label: 다람쥐
recommended_replacements.reason: Three finger-like tips on each ear read as small human hands raised above the head. This is the clearest mismatch with the user's strictly cute direction.
recommended_replacements.recommendation: Replace with a rounded squirrel ear with a tiny soft fur tuft. Preserve the category count by replacing under the same ID.

recommended_replacements.label: 털뭉치
recommended_replacements.reason: No drawn hands and no arms mask. Every handheld item floats in front of the tummy.
recommended_replacements.recommendation: Replace the body with the same fluffy silhouette plus two short inward-facing C-shaped hands at x34%/66%, y69%. New body_27 demonstrates a compatible fluffy silhouette.

recommended_replacements.label: 가슴 털
recommended_replacements.reason: Hands sit near the outer cheeks; the large scalloped white chest patch has a black outline. The item becomes oversized while still missing the hands, and chest ink competes with the item silhouette.
recommended_replacements.recommendation: Replace or redraw with hands near the center, reduce chest patch to a small soft unoutlined spot, and place prop width near 33% of body width.

recommended_replacements.label: 배 동그라미
recommended_replacements.reason: An outlined circular belly patch sits exactly behind the handheld item, producing duplicate concentric outlines. The separated outer hands cannot naturally hold the current centered prop.
recommended_replacements.recommendation: Replace or redraw with a very pale unoutlined belly patch, hands at x34%/66%, y69%, and a prop width near 33% of body width.

recommended_replacements.label: 흰 배
recommended_replacements.reason: Wide hand separation forces a large centered prop. A round prop then crowds the mouth; making the prop smaller prevents contact with both hands.
recommended_replacements.recommendation: Second-priority redraw: retain the white belly and rounded silhouette, move hands inward. An anchor-only prop shrink does not solve hand contact.

optional_geometry_refinements.label: 사막여우
optional_geometry_refinements.recommendation: Reduce the ear pair to 82–88% of current logical size to retain the large-ear character without overwhelming compact bodies. Scale half w/h/root together so bases stay attached; do not just shrink images around their centers.

optional_geometry_refinements.label: 박쥐
optional_geometry_refinements.recommendation: Keep as a playful fantasy ear. Optional 88–92% reduction softens the long sharp tips. This is a style preference, not a confirmed defect.

optional_geometry_refinements.label: 배동글 모찌
optional_geometry_refinements.recommendation: The narrower pear-shaped crown makes round ears look farther apart than on the other new bodies. Optional anchors x=crownX±22%W (currently ±27.5%W), recompute each y from the silhouette, and reduce headW from 82%W to about 66–70%W for hats. Face and prop alignment currently remain natural.

keep.notes: Most existing silhouettes are cute. body_15's tall egg proportion still reads as cute and has naturally aligned face/hands; no need to remove merely for being taller. ears_09's earlier color mismatch is resolved by coat recoloring in current engine logic. New bodies' existing-ear joins and face/prop placement are otherwise natural in the 36-case stress contact sheet.

follow_up.validation: 144 body/prop combinations composed with current ear and face catalog and visually checked.
